prompts.description: Reset scroll to top on Grocery List page mount
prompts.prompt: In components/grocery-list.tsx, the page currently opens with the scroll position inherited from the previous screen (often scrolled to the bottom). Add a useEffect that runs once on mount and calls window.scrollTo(0, 0) so the Grocery List always opens at the top. If the component already has a useEffect, add a separate one rather than merging unrelated logic. Do NOT change any other behavior, the ScrollToTop button, or grocery rendering logic. Verify: npm run build passes and navigating into the Full weekly shopping list page opens scrolled to the top.

prompts.description: Show macro info immediately after AI ingredient lookup, before the user adds it
prompts.prompt: In components/onboarding.tsx, find the flow where fetchIngredientViaClaude looks up a custom ingredient not in the catalog. There is an existing pending-state UI (pendingClaudeIngredient or similar) shown after lookup with an inline category picker, before the ingredient is committed to the catalog. Locate that pending UI. Add a compact macro preview row to it so the user sees nutrition data BEFORE pressing Add: display per-100g calories, protein, carbs, and fat from the looked-up data (e.g. '120 kcal · P 22g · C 0g · F 3g'). Style it as a small muted text row (text-sm, text-muted-foreground) directly under the ingredient name. Use the exact field names already returned by the lookup (name, calories, protein, carbs, fat). If a value is missing, omit that token gracefully. Do NOT change fetchIngredientViaClaude, the category picker logic, the add-to-catalog behavior, or the API route. Display only. Verify: npm run build passes; after an AI lookup, the macro numbers appear in the pending UI before the ingredient is added.
